column1: # soundness/known_open_handoff.tsv — the KNOWN-OPEN register for soundness/run_handoff.sh. Its own file because
# soundness/baseline.sh regenerates known_open.tsv from the two property gates and would drop these.
# kind h — soundness/run_handoff.sh (gen_drop.py --handoff), MEASURED over the full 120-cell grid.
# rustagent-v050: EMPTY — the six cells measured at rustagent-v049 (published 0.40.6: 23 silent cells) all
# closed: the closure-parameter tail cells by SOUNDNESS R1129's closure half (a typed by-value closure
# parameter its body never consumes is released there), and both `qret` cells by R1129's opaque-parameter
# rule (an argument at a generic / `impl Trait` parameter the callee's signature names nowhere else stays the
# caller's charge on the `?` spine). Their old entries, for the record:
#   (closed) closure-param target in TAIL position: `let f = |_h: H| {}; f(V)` — the callee is a local VALUE,
#     so R200's unit-callee rule refuses it and the argument stays on the escape spine.
#   (closed) qret + generic / closure, direct: `let x = callee(H::new(), n)?; Ok(x)` — R194 exempts the by-value
#     argument on the `?` operand's spine because the callee is supposed to carry the charge, and a
#     generic parameter or a closure parameter cannot (R1121's stated residual).
